description: re = /\A#{seg}\z/ -- a regexp literal built by **interpolation**, which is how `semver.rb` writes `SEMVER_REGEX` (four interpolated constants) and `identify.rb` writes its per-forge patterns (`Regexp.escape(host)` spliced into a pattern). The consequence for the checker is that a `regexp_lit`'s source is not always static, so nothing can be read off the pattern text -- a `Regexp` is opaque, which is the conservative answer and, this rung argues, the right one.
